'''Tasty Dried Critters''', or '''TDC''', was a [[fast food]] franchise based in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and owned by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Byxle Pedette]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Hey, I think something is still moving in there.''"<br />"''That's how you know it's fresh.''"<br />"''Real funny, pal.''"<br />"''You're serious, aren't you?''"<br />"''Yes! Look at it. Wait a minute&hellip; It's eating the rest of my order!|Nogri Hessen takes a delivery from a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TDC" />}}
[[File:Chuba.png|thumb|Chewy chubas were a popular menu choice at TDC]]

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Byxle Pedette]] was the owner of the only Tasty Dried Critters [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], a city located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At the time, the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] served, among other things, dried [[Gnort/Legends|gnort]], chewy [[Gorg/Legends|chuba]] (popular choices) and [[fungus dippers]]. Pedette also planned on serving [[Squill (creature)|squill]] meat.<ref name="SWG:TDC" />

During this period of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Pedette's Tasty Dried Critters was receiving so many orders that he had to ask a passing [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deliver three extra orders for a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as a freelance job. The spacer agreed and Pedette gave him the location of the deliveries and told him he could keep any tips he got and not to forget the company slogan, "TDC is not fast food, it's food delivered fast."<ref name="SWG:TDC" />

When the spacer got to the first location, the house of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Drixa Dreul]], Drixa found out that Pedette hadn't given the spacer [[fungus dippers]] she'd ordered. After the first delivery, Pedette called the spacer and told him Dreul hadn't paid for the fungus dippers or the spacers tip, but he said it wasn't his fault, Drixa always had something to complain about. The next delivery was at the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Nogri Hessen]]'s house. When the spacer arrived it turned out the stuffed chuba was still alive and eating the rest of the food. The Trandoshan didn't pay for the delivery, but Pedette called and said that Hessen told him about the food and believed him and said he'd still pay him for the delivery, and also told him to be careful about the next location, as the delivery was for the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] leader [[Jano Bix]].<ref name="SWG:TDC" />

The spacer arrived for the delivery and was immediately surrounded by swoop riders. When the spacer got to Bix, everything was going well until the four chubas the spacer was supposed to deliver attacked Bix and the spacer. After killing the chubas, Bix threatened the spacer, but the individual tried to reason with him, saying that Pedette had just made a mistake. Bix let him go, and when the spacer returned to Pedette, he was paid and let go.<ref name="SWG:TDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tasty Dried Critters appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TDC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tasty Dried Critters was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
